note_for_next_ai: The repo is the source of truth, not any handover text. Verify a file exists before trusting a status list. ALWAYS re-align with the remote before committing: the sandbox snapshot can come back stale (git-restore ritual: re-add origin, fetch, reset --mixed onto the remote tip). The app is AI ASSistant, NOT a Claude clone - do not reintroduce Claude branding. Nothing fake goes in front of the user: a screen may not exist without working; no test may depend on a mock engine (the scripted shim used for live drives in the sandbox is NOT shipped and no test imports it). The engines do the work: the app spawns the engine binary on its own wire in its own folder; the app never talks to model APIs for engine work. Permission cards are the only approval path. Owner's hardware reality: 8GB RAM / 4GB VRAM - keep bundles lean; quantized local brains only.
